title: Policy Conditions — The Insured's Cancellation of an Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Policy and Return of Premium
content:
The named insured may cancel an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy; these conditions govern the cancellation and the premium returned.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force** as written. Each is superseded by the current basis: a cancellation because the home was sold, where the Tidemark HomeFlood policy named as the underlying has been cancelled for that sale, is made and figured on the current basis for such sale cancellations; for every other cancellation the in-force wording stated after each clause applies.

| Retired clause | In force for every other cancellation |
|---|---|
| A cancellation is processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request on file for the policy, and only on a policy whose status is pending effective or active, which it leaves cancelled. | Processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request on file for the policy, and only on a policy whose status is pending effective or active, which it leaves cancelled. |
| A property-sold cancellation takes effect on the closing date on the settlement statement. | Every other cancellation for a sale takes effect on the closing date on the settlement statement. |
| Under the pro rata method with minimum earned premium the earned premium is the larger of the term premium multiplied by the days from the term start to the cancellation effective date divided by the days from the term start to the term end, and the tier's minimum earned premium percentage of the term premium; the returned premium is the term premium less the earned premium, rounded to the cent. | The earned premium is the larger of the term premium multiplied by the days from the term start to the cancellation effective date divided by the days from the term start to the term end, and the tier's minimum earned premium percentage of the term premium, and the returned premium is the term premium less the earned premium, rounded to the cent. |
| When the tier makes the term premium fully earned after a paid claim and a claim with a date of loss in the term has a net payment above zero, nothing is returned. | Nothing is returned when a claim with a date of loss in the term has a net payment above zero. |

## Clauses in force

1. The request states one reason: property sold; the underlying replaced or ended; or the insured's request. A cancellation for the underlying replaced or ended, or at the insured's request, takes effect on the date the signed request is received or a later date the insured names; a cancellation before the effective date takes effect on the effective date.
2. The policy fee is fully earned.
3. When the tier returns taxes with premium, the surplus lines tax and stamping fee on the returned premium are returned at the policy's recorded rates, each rounded to the cent.
4. Each returned item is booked as a cancellation credit referencing the request and the total is refunded to the insured.

The signed request is the named insured's own document on file for this policy; the policy's status is read from its record.

## Return on an insured's request, worked (hypothetical figures)

Term premium 2000.00 for a 365-day term, cancelled with 100 days run, minimum earned share 25 percent, no paid claim in the term: pro rata earned is 547.95 and the minimum earned is 500.00, so the earned premium is 547.95 and the returned premium is 1452.05, with tax and stamping fee on 1452.05 returned at the recorded rates.

superseded_clauses: A cancellation is processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request on file for the policy, and only on a policy whose status is pending_effective or active, which it leaves cancelled.
PROPERTY_SOLD takes effect on the closing date on the settlement statement

Under PRO_RATA_WITH_MINIMUM_EARNED the earned premium is the larger of the term premium multiplied by the days from term_start to the cancellation effective date divided by the days from term_start to term_end, and minimum_earned_premium_pct of the term premium; the returned premium is the term premium less the earned premium, rounded to the cent.
When no_refund_after_paid_claim is true and a claim with a date of loss in the term has a net payment above zero (excess_msr_term_claims_paid above zero), nothing is returned.
